description: Since v14, `FormControl<string>`, `FormGroup<{...}>` and `FormArray<...>` carry value types, so `form.value.email` is typed.
A `FormBuilder` whose controls are non-nullable by default (`inject(NonNullableFormBuilder)` or `fb.nonNullable`).
`(control: AbstractControl) => ValidationErrors | null`. Return an error object to mark the control invalid.
A function that takes configuration and returns a `ValidatorFn`, like `Validators.minLength(8)` or `forbiddenNameValidator(['admin'])`.
A validator on a `FormGroup` that compares children. Its error is set on the group, not on a child.
An ordered list of controls for dynamic fields. Bind with `formArrayName` and index-based `[formControlName]`.
Returns `Promise`/`Observable` of errors, e.g. a server check. While running, the control is `pending`.
